newsitem.title: UK: NWE gas oil barge spreads firm, cargoes languish.
newsitem.headline: NWE gas oil barge spreads firm, cargoes languish.

text.p: European gas oil barge activity picked up on Wednesday with both small and large parcels moving at steady differentials, traders said.
Cargoes were discussed but lack of arbitrage, firmer outright values and an unimpressive Aug/Sep screen spread resulted in a near inactive market.
Front month August IPE last traded up $3.25 at $171 on bullish U.S. stocks data.
Barge buying interest has been stirred by a spate of purchases by a French major, and a 10,000 tonne barge of Rotterdam refinery heating oil moved at August IPE +$1 for the second half of August.
A 2,000 tonne parcel of Rotterdam refinery went for August +$0.75 and +$0.50 for first half August.
A 2,500 tonne barge of Rotterdam refinery low sulphur diesel moved at August IPE +$4 fob ARA for the first half of August. Another barge went for August IPE +$3.75 fob ARA for before August 5.
On cargoes, German heating oil was bid at around August IPE +$1/$1.50 and offered at August +$3 for early August. GOM quality gas oil was bid at August +$4.25 and offered at +$5.50.
